description: Use this to set the same payer, category, split, date or time on several expenses at once. List each one in transactions with its token and, as expectedRevision, its lockVersion from list_transactions.

BatchSplit.description:
The people every expense is split between. Weights are percentages or share counts for
those split types; an equal split ignores them. Each new name joins the group as a member,
or reuses the member who already has it.

members.description: Members who share each expense. Give at least one, here or in `newMemberNames`.

newMemberNames.description:
More people to share each expense, by name. A name matching a member's
(ignoring case) uses that member; any other joins the group as a new one.

type.description: How each total is divided among `members`.

weight.description:
This member's percentage or number of shares. Each total is divided in
proportion to the weights, so percentages need not add up to 100.
Omitted is 1; an equal split ignores it.

Token.description:
Resource token: 24 base58 characters (the alphabet leaves out the
look-alikes `0`, `O`, `I` and `l`). A token never changes. The server
generates one when a create sends none; a client may choose its own for a
transaction, participant, category or recurring expense, so a write queued
offline already knows the token it will have.

TransactionBatchItem.description: One transaction in a batch, with the revision the caller last saw.

expectedRevision.description: The transaction's `lockVersion` when the caller read it.

categoryToken.description: The group category to file the expenses under, by token from `showGroup`. Payments keep none.

date.description: The day to move every one of them to, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

paidByParticipantToken.description: The member who paid every one of them, payments included, by token from `showGroup`.

split.description: Who shares each expense; every expense's total is divided again. Payments are left as they are.

timeOfDay.description: The time of day to give every one of them, `HH:MM` (24-hour).

transactions.description: The transactions to change, all in this group. If one has moved past its revision, none change.

name: bulk_edit_expenses
title: Edit several expenses
